name: eBS eBoost Street 40psi
title: eBS eBoost Street 40psi
description:
The eBS eBoost Street 40psi is an advanced electronic boost controller capable of handling high boost levels with multiple boost group settings and boost-by-gear control.

Technical Specifications:
• Brand & Engineering: Genuine Turbosmart high-performance motorsport hardware.
• Construction: Precision CNC-machined billet aluminum housing with hard-anodized finish.
• Pressure Rating: Rated up to 40psi for high-output turbocharged applications.
• Feature Set: Peak hold display, auxiliary output control, and programmable boost curve ramps.
